pending_commit.commit_message: shill: cellular: drop 'universal' in cellular capability Given that those legacy cellular capability classes have been removed, it's no longer necessary to keep 'universal' in the naming of the remaining cellular capability classes, which are renamed in this CL as follows: CellularCapabilityUniversal -> CellularCapability3gpp CellularCapabilityUniversalCdma -> CellularCapabilityCdma This CL is generated with the following commands: sed -i \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversalCdma/CapabilityCdma/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL_CDMA/CAPABILITY_CDMA/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal_cdma/capability_cdma/g' \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversal/Capability3gpp/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL/CAPABILITY_3GPP/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal/capability_3gpp/g' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversalCdma/kTypeCdma/gI' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversal/kType3gpp/gI' \ $(git ls-files '*.h' '*.cc') BUILD.gn git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}_test.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma_test.cc git cl format BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. tast.camera/video.*: Cleanup open Chrome tabs after running test. A lot of tests don't explicitely close open Chrome tabs at the end of the test run, which can affect the results of further test runs. Unfortunately calling 'conn.Close()' doesn't clean up these tabs. An additional call to 'conn.CloseTarget(ctx)' is required to do so. This CL makes sure all tests under camera/video close their open Chrome tabs at the end of the test run. mesa: explicitly use shared libgcc. For clang toolchain, we are changing the default for unwinder library from shared library to static library. Since mesa is explicitly requesting the libgcc library, let's explicitly request the share library version to keep the old behavior. There is no functional change here. It just allows us to change the default. Also note that, for Chrome OS, libgcc is mostly not used. It has been replaced by llvm/compiler-rt. The only remaining part in use from libgcc is libgcc_eh (for unwinding). BUG=chromium:972454 TEST=None. No functional change. tast.video.*Perf: Improve CPU measurement logic for performance tests. This CL improves the CPU measurement logic used in Tast performance tests: - MeasureProcessCPU will no longer write the measured CPU usage to disk. This is error prone and makes it very difficult to reuse this function. - A duration parameter is added to MeasureProcessCPU so each tests can specify a different measurement duration. - The logic to cleanup a process after measurement has been improved, reducing the change of a process not properly being killed. - Extract SetUpBenchmark from MeasureProcessCPU, to avoid being called multiple times when doing multiple measurements. The testcase is now responsible for properly setting up benchmark mode. - SetUpBenchmark no longer returns a context. It is sometimes necessary to have a shorter context even before calling SetUpBenchmark, so this is the reponsibility of the test case. - DisableCPUFrequencyScaling and DisableThermalThrottling are made private.
